# Blue Ocean Heilbronn Wave 0 feedback form

Version: `N9-HW0-FEEDBACK-2026-08-24.1`

Status: **BLANK TEMPLATE — NO PARTICIPANT DATA**

Use one temporary copy per authorized flow outside Git. Transfer only reviewed,
anonymous aggregate counts to the final pilot handover. Do not enter names,
emails, phone numbers, account IDs, exact addresses, device/network IDs, raw
messages, photos, payment facts or other free-text personal data here.

## Flow reference

- Opaque participant slot: `HW0-A | HW0-B | HW0-C`
- Opaque flow number: `01–15`
- Object task: `clear | used-functional | accessories | optional-category`
- Outcome: `completed | abandoned | manual-fallback | paused | aborted`

## Listing experience

- Stage-A non-binding/no-money notice understood: `yes | no`
- AI disclosure understood: `yes | no | provider-not-used`
- Photo guidance clear: `1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5`
- Draft usefulness: `1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | not-generated`
- Category suggestion: `correct | edited | unavailable`
- Brand/model suggestion: `both-correct | one-edited | both-edited | unavailable`
- Unsupported claim observed: `yes | no`
- Price choice: `accepted | edited-up | edited-down | unavailable`
- Clarification count: `0 | 1 | 2 | 3`
- Manual fallback used: `yes | no`
- Ready-to-publish confidence: `1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5`

## Growth and downstream flow

- Planner used: `yes | no | not-in-scope`
- Search completed: `yes | no`
- Mietkorb understood as non-reserving: `yes | no | not-used`
- Request outcome: `accepted | rejected | not-submitted`
- Simulated completion: `completed | not-completed`
- Treffpunkt label: `A | B | C | not-used`
- Support needed: `none | usability | accessibility | technical | privacy-safety`

## Safety and stop result

- Sensitive content entered: `no | suspected-and-blocked`
- Real-money/live/public signal: `no | abort`
- Severity: `none | P2 | P1 | P0`
- Final action: `continue | pause-flow | abort-wave`

Optional feedback must be summarized into one reviewed non-personal issue code;
do not copy raw participant wording into Git.
